definitions.gloss: tax affairs; tax administration; tax matters
definitions.explanation: Matters and work relating to taxes — filing, assessment, payment, and the administration of tax law. Used attributively in the names of offices, jobs, and procedures.

examples.japanese: {税務|ぜいむ}の{手続|てつづ}きは{複雑|ふくざつ}だ。
{確定申告|かくていしんこく}のために{税務署|ぜいむしょ}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the tax office to file my income tax return.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{税理士|ぜいりし}に{税務|ぜいむ}に{関|かん}する{相談|そうだん}をしている。
examples.english: The company consults a tax accountant on tax matters.

notes:
A term from business and public administration. It appears mostly in compounds rather than on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税務署|ぜいむしょ}: tax office
- {税務|ぜいむ}{調査|ちょうさ}: tax audit; tax investigation
- {税務|ぜいむ}{申告|しんこく}: tax filing
- {税務|ぜいむ}{処理|しょり}: tax processing/accounting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {財務|ざいむ}: financial affairs — the broader management of an organization's finances, not specifically taxes
- {経理|けいり}: accounting/bookkeeping — the day-to-day handling of a company's accounts
